thread:
maria: Heads-up — we have a microdeploy tomorrow 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Need someone to finalize the internal release blurb and confirm model pin/rollback lanes. I'll own external announce. Can one of you take RN + ops notes? :eyes:

sam: I'll take it. Draft below — please quick edit.

sam:
```
Release notes (internal):
- Feature: dynamic batching + small memory leak fix in kv-cache.
- Models: serving v2.4 (quant-opt)
- Behavioral changes: slightly lower latency variance for long-context workloads.
- Rollback: pin to v2.3 (non-quant) if error rate > 1.5% or median latency > 200ms for 5m.
```

liz: Add: emergency fallback to hosted-lite model when GPU pool saturates. Also add who to page: @oncall-ml and @infra-oncall.

anita: Change window check — 10:00 PT works for NA; APAC cutover nil. Confirming legal sign-off not needed.

deploy-bot: /deploy schedule microdeploy r20260324 --window 2026-03-24T17:00Z --canary 5% --owners @sam @maria

maria: Thanks. Sam — can you fold Liz's fallback line and make the rollback thresholds a single line? Then drop final blurb here.

sam: Updated, short blurb below.

sam:
```
Internal blurb: Microdeploy 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Deploys dynamic batching and kv-cache fix. Models served: v2.4 (quant-opt). Rollback -> v2.3 if error rate >1.5% OR median token latency >200ms sustained 5m. Fallback: route to hosted-lite when GPU pool >90% util. Page: @oncall-ml, @infra-oncall.
```

ops-bot: Reminder: model pin expiration must be set in rollout config. Use `pin_version=2.4` and `pin_ttl=72h` if temporary. Also make an entry in incidents-runbook for rollback triggers.

liz: +1 from me. I'll add the runbook snippet.

anita: ack — support loop notified. I'll post short heads-up to #support at T-2h.

maria: Perfect. Sam — leave it here and I'll merge into the final internal announce doc by EOD. :rocket:
